8.2 Macros
OSMEMORY_IS_READABLE(<AccessType>)
OSMEMORY_IS_WRITEABLE(<AccessType>)
OSMEMORY_IS_EXECUTABLE(<AccessType>)
OSMEMORY_IS_STACKSPACE(<AccessType>) These macros return a value not equal to zero if the memory is readable / writable / executable or stack space. The argument of the macros must be of type AccessType. Typically the return value of the service CheckTaskMemoryAccess (or CheckISRMemoryAccess) is used as argument for these macros.
